'''Alaphoe Gardens''' was a collection of unique architecture and plant life located on [[Lalos Island]], of the planet [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]]. It was considered the most spectacular site on the planet. The site consisted of the gardens, riding stables, a concert hall, and the [[Glass Palace]]. The noble families of [[House Cadriaan]] often held parties and reunions at Alaphoe Gardens during [[Capital Season]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the Campaign guide of the Lords of the Expanse boxset the gardens are described as analogous to the [[:Wikipedia:18th century|18th century]] [[:Wikipedia:Palace of Versailles|Versailles]] - with concerts, fireworks and lawn parties attended by finely dressed aristocrats.
